summary: All 6815 tests pass after integration fixes. 16 test failures from coder/tester agents resolved.

issues_found.description: Push-target enforcement code used truthiness checks on session attributes (pipeline_id, assigned_branch) which fire on MagicMock auto-attributes in tests. 16 tests failed with 'Object of type MagicMock is not JSON serializable' at gateway.py:641.
issues_found.fix: Changed `if session_pipeline_id and session_assigned_branch:` to `if isinstance(session_pipeline_id, str) and isinstance(session_assigned_branch, str):` at two locations in gateway.py (lines 628 and 849).

issues_found.description: setup_command_timeout() called logger.warning() but the custom Logger class only defines logger.warn(). Mypy error: '"Logger" has no attribute "warning"'.
issues_found.fix: Changed logger.warning() to logger.warn() in sandbox/entrypoint.py:1043.

issues_found.description: test_command_timeout.py missing return type annotations on 9 test methods and fixture. Also missing type parameter on CompletedProcess generic.
issues_found.fix: Added -> None return type annotations to all test methods and -> Path to fixture. Changed CompletedProcess to CompletedProcess[str].

gateway.notes: Enforcement correctly blocks pushes to non-assigned branches, handles refspec formats, respects killswitch, exempts checkpoint pushes.

orchestrator.feature: Completion signal branch verification + worktree sync
orchestrator.tests_in_scope: test_signals.py (21 tests), test_sync_worktree.py (11 tests), test_models.py (new fields)
orchestrator.notes: Branch verification rejects commits on wrong branch (409), handles fetch failures gracefully. Worktree sync correctly pushes/discards local-ahead commits based on prior phase outcome.

sandbox.notes: Wrapper correctly kills long-running commands, preserves exit codes, passes through non -c invocations, respects disable flag.

documentation.feature: Updated docs for all three features
documentation.notes: Documentation accurately reflects code implementations. Covers push-target enforcement, command timeout, and worktree sync behaviors.

cross_component_integration.notes: The three features (gateway push-target enforcement, orchestrator branch verification, sandbox command timeout) are complementary defense-in-depth layers that operate independently. No cross-component coupling issues found. Gateway blocks wrong-branch pushes at push time; orchestrator verifies at signal time; sandbox prevents the root cause (runaway commands) at execution time.
